title: Children as Config: Menu
prompt:
Iterate over `Children` to read the configuration your component needs. **Requirements:** 1. Import `Children`, `isValidElement`, `ReactNode` from `react`. 2. Export `MenuItem({ label, onSelect })` with `label: string` and `onSelect: () => void`. The implementation can render `null` -- it's configuration, not display. 3. Export `Menu({ children })` that: - Walks `Children.toArray(children)` - Keeps only elements where `isValidElement(el) && el.type === MenuItem` - Renders a `
    ` with one `
    • ` per item. Callers describe the menu declaratively with ``; your component interprets the children.
hints: `Children.toArray(children)` handles strings, fragments, and nulls uniformly.
Use a type guard in `filter` so the result is narrowed to `ReactElement<MenuItemProps>`.
Comparing `child.type === MenuItem` is safer than string checks -- the identity match is unambiguous.
